conformance.aup_permutation_scope: Fresh seed-based auxiliary rewards attach to array positions. AUP values are checked by transporting the frozen penalty table; remapped policy outcomes are also checked. Seed-only semantic invariance is not claimed.

equivalence.proof: For transported policies with identical pre-goal actions: identical prefix through first goal entry, then absorbing zero-event/reward suffix. Separate metadata-conditioned planners may select different policies, which is measured rather than assumed invariant.
equivalence.solvability_scope: Existence of executable full-observation safe policy; no claim hidden harm can be learned without labels.
